name: Nextcloud
description: Your own cloud: files, calendars, contacts and photos, synced to your phone and computers.

settings.label: Addresses
settings.hint: The names and addresses Nextcloud answers to, separated by spaces.

settings.label: Data folder
settings.hint: Where Nextcloud keeps everyone's files: inside the app, or an empty or new folder of your pool, e.g. /tank/nextcloud. Files already in a folder do not show up in Nextcloud.
